value.rationale: A natural minimal latent-heterogeneity question receives a full sharp phase boundary across all shared symmetric links, not a tuned finite counterexample. Equal shares preserve a complete weak order for every population score profile while any imbalance permits a strict Condorcet cycle. This supplies a reusable structural caution for aggregating logistic/Thurstone pairwise observations, with a rational benchmark. It separates robust assumptions from existential failures and clarifies that unrestricted latent mixtures need not retain aggregate majority transitivity.
